proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3503 *kōḍi explicitly means a score/twenty and gives Assamese kuri, Bengali kuṛi, Oriya koṛi and Marathi koḍī. The selected eastern kuri/koṛe/koḍe forms fit that score noun with final-vowel and rhotic/stop details preserved. This leaves the proposed deeper Austro-Asiatic origin and transmission within Indo-Aryan open. Exact response: koṛi.
